answer: Sybil resistance via a hash-chained work log: each new agent must publish a signed quill entry every 10 minutes for 7 days, anchored to a public beacon value so it cannot be precomputed. A jetty server rate-limits registration to 5 identities per subnet daily. Faking 1,000 identities costs roughly 1,000 weeks of compute plus about 200 dollars in hosting.
